challenge.method: Tested a 1.2-or-later notice with one properly listed Back-Cover Text and zero Invariant Sections against the three-placeholder example. Also tested zero designations, an unavailable notice, removal of the later-version clause, and a proposed unpublished successor.
challenge.results: One qualifying Back-Cover Text satisfies the feature condition. GNU's Addendum expressly accommodates mixed combinations. Zero designations defeat the positive-feature assertion, and an unavailable notice cannot establish it. Removing later-version permission from the numbered grant changes the edition choice. Section 10 admits a later edition published by the FSF in final form and excludes the draft. A grant starting at 1.3 has a different starting edition.

limitations: GNU section 1 requires a designated Invariant Section to be a qualifying Secondary Section identified by title. Cover Texts are passages listed in the notice, limited to five words for the front and 25 for the back. A heading or cover inscription alone does not establish designation.
